display_long_description:
**Try to escape from rooms filled with unique puzzles and mechanics.
Thrills against time and an atmosphere blended with horror elements await you!**

**DEMO VERSION Link:** https://vr.meta.me/s/2olf0bWAF8stA2i
- Playing the 2-level demo version and leaving a comment will help us a lot while we develop the game. We’re looking forward to your feedback!

[media]
**Strange sounds echo around you, eerie reflections distort reality, and an unsettling atmosphere surrounds everything. Experience it in full.**
[media]
**Sometimes simple, sometimes hiding in plain sight—so obvious you’ll wonder how you missed it—and sometimes demanding intense focus and thought, the puzzles will test you at every turn.**
[media]
**In a tense, unsettling environment, you must control your emotions while solving the puzzles. Any rushed or thoughtless move will turn the rooms into places you can never escape.**
